articles.title: Bengaluru engineer Gaurav Sen builds AI system to detect potholes and track road contractors
articles.description: Bengaluru -based engineer Gaurav Sen has built an AI -powered system to detect potholes using dashcam footage. It cross-references their locations with government road contracts to find out the contractor and officer responsible for repairs. Gaurav Sen builds AI system to detect potholes and track road contractors The system u ses dashcam footage captured during regular drives to spot potholes and then matches their locations with government road contracts. The goal is to identify the contractor responsible for the damaged stretch, along with the relevant tender number and government officer overseeing the work. Sen equipped his car with a dashcam, GPS unit and accelerometer to collect road footage as he travelled around the city. Once a pothole is detected, its location is cross-referenced with a database containing details of around 2,900 government road contracts. The system then attempts to determine which contractor was responsible for that particular stretch of road and identifies the associated tender and government official. Roads are often covered by contractual warranties, under which contractors are required to repair defects such as potholes during the warranty period without charging the government additional money. The system is designed to connect a pothole directly to the contract under which the road was built. This, in turn, could make it easier to establish responsibility and direct complaints to the appropriate authorities. For every pothole it detects, the system creates a record containing a geo-tagged photograph, the location, tender details and the officer responsible for overseeing the work. The information is then compiled into what Sen describes as a ready-to-file complaint. In one test during a single commute, the system detected 12 potholes and generated 12 corresponding complaints, according to his post. “Over 2000 Indians die every year due to so called "pothole" related accidents,” Gaurav Sen captioned the video post on Instagram. “Here is how I used Codex to report them to BBMP.” View this post on Instagram Also read: Maharashtra suspends permits of 12 warehouses of Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy after cockroaches, rats were found
